speaker: davy_gannet
text: Drake's out! Sir Francis and old Hawkins, from Plymouth, six-and-thirty sail and four thousand men, gone to burn the King of Spain in his bed. And it'll blow.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Hold the boat, Davy. We came down for the air. We are not crossing.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Seven days it's been going, and Paul's hasn't got it. The river had it first. They went out on Thursday the eight-and-twentieth. Here's to Frankie Drake.

speaker: george_bryan
text: You are out by your usual third, and the third has gone upward. The letters from the west say seven-and-twenty ships, and some five-and-twenty hundred men.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Seven-and-twenty, then, if you must have the letters. Two old sea-dogs in one command never yet made easy sailing. I'll say that lower.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The Indies. The Isthmus. The plate fleet. Three guesses on this stair, and not one a man could swear to.

speaker: (a man on the top step)
text: It is the answer for Penzance.

speaker: george_bryan
text: That's what the ballad will say. Nobody's told me so.

speaker: (the ballad-seller)
text: A ship on a sheet, masters. She's served for three other voyages. The words are rubbed. You don't have to buy them.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It'll be spring before we know.

speaker: george_bryan
text: That's the only sentence on these stairs that doesn't pretend to a harbour. The sheet stays where it is. We're walking.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Spring I'll give you. You're on the City side. Stay on it.
